039/**
040 * {@link TokenValidator} that validates opaque OAuth 2.0 access tokens via the
041 * <a class="doclink" href="https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7662">RFC 7662</a> Token Introspection
042 * endpoint.
043 *
044 * <p>
045 * Wraps Nimbus's {@code TokenIntrospectionRequest} / {@code TokenIntrospectionResponse} for the HTTP
046 * round-trip and the JSON parsing.  A {@link TokenCache} (default: bounded LRU cache) short-circuits
047 * the round-trip on repeated lookups within the configured TTL window.
048 *
049 * <h2 class='topic'>Usage</h2>
050 *
051 * <p class='bjava'>
052 *    <jk>var</jk> validator = OAuthIntrospectionValidator.<jsm>create</jsm>()
053 *       .introspectionEndpoint(URI.<jsm>create</jsm>(<js>"https://idp.example.com/oauth2/introspect"</js>))
054 *       .clientId(<js>"api-server"</js>)
055 *       .clientSecret(<js>"..."</js>)
056 *       .audience(<js>"https://api.example.com"</js>)
057 *       .requiredScopes(<js>"read:orders"</js>)
058 *       .build();
059 * </p>
060 *
061 * <h2 class='topic'>Defaults</h2>
062 * <ul>
063 *    <li>Audience: required.  {@link Builder#build()} fails unless {@link Builder#audience(String...)} (or
064 *       {@link Builder#resource(String...)}) or an explicit {@link Builder#anyAudience()} is set.
065 *    <li>HTTP timeouts: 5 seconds connect and read.
066 *    <li>Cache TTL: 5 minutes, capped at 1 hour.
067 *    <li>Cache size: 1000 entries.
068 *    <li>Negative cache: inactive or rejected tokens are remembered for 30 seconds.
069 *    <li>Required scopes: none (scope enforcement lives on the validator, not the filter).
070 * </ul>
071 *
072 * <h2 class='section'>See Also:</h2>
073 * <ul>
074 *    <li class='jc'>{@link OAuthFilter}
075 *    <li class='jc'>{@link TokenValidator}
076 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7662">RFC 7662 &mdash; OAuth 2.0 Token Introspection</a>
077 * </ul>
078 *
079 * @since 10.0.0
080 */
081@SuppressWarnings({
082   "java:S1192" // Duplicate string literals are OAuth introspection response field names; intentional
083})
084public class OAuthIntrospectionValidator implements TokenValidator {
085
086   /** Default cache TTL. */
087   public static final Duration DEFAULT_CACHE_TTL = Duration.ofMinutes(5);
088
089   /** Maximum cache TTL. */
090   public static final Duration MAX_CACHE_TTL = Duration.ofHours(1);
091
092   /** Default connect/read timeout for the introspection call. */
093   public static final Duration DEFAULT_HTTP_TIMEOUT = Duration.ofSeconds(5);
094
095   /** Default time an inactive or rejected token is remembered. */
096   public static final Duration DEFAULT_NEGATIVE_CACHE_TTL = Duration.ofSeconds(30);
097
098   private static final int MAX_NEGATIVE_ENTRIES = 1000;
099

101    * Static creator.

104    */
105   public static Builder create() {
106      return new Builder();

109   /**
110    * Builder for {@link OAuthIntrospectionValidator}.
111    */
112   public static class Builder {
113      private URI introspectionEndpoint;
114      private String clientId;
115      private Supplier<String> clientSecretSupplier;
116      private TokenCache tokenCache;
117      private Duration cacheTtl = DEFAULT_CACHE_TTL;
118      private final Set<String> requiredScopes = st();
119      private final Set<String> expectedAudiences = st();
120      private Clock clock = Clock.systemUTC();
121      private Consumer<HTTPRequest> httpRequestConfigurator;
122      private String issuer;
123      private boolean anyAudience;
124      private Duration httpTimeout = DEFAULT_HTTP_TIMEOUT;
125      private Duration negativeCacheTtl = DEFAULT_NEGATIVE_CACHE_TTL;
126      private boolean requireTokenType;

128      /** Constructor. */
129      protected Builder() {}

131      /**
132       * Sets the introspection endpoint URL.  Required.
133       *
134       * <p>
135       * Each introspection call transmits the client secret (HTTP Basic) and the access token under
136       * validation to this endpoint, so the URL must use <js>"https"</js> or target a loopback host; a
137       * plaintext transport to a non-loopback host is rejected.
138       *
139       * @param value The endpoint URL.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> and must use HTTPS or target a loopback host.
140       * @return This object.
141       */
142      public Builder introspectionEndpoint(URI value) {
143         introspectionEndpoint = assertSecureOrLoopback(reqnn("value", value));
144         return this;
145      }
146
147      /**
148       * Sets the OAuth client ID used for HTTP Basic auth against the introspection endpoint.
149       *
150       * @param value The client ID.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
151       * @return This object.
152       */
153      public Builder clientId(String value) {
154         clientId = reqnb("value", value);
155         return this;
156      }
157
158      /**
159       * Sets the OAuth client secret as a literal string.
160       *
161       * <p>
162       * Mutually exclusive with {@link #clientSecretSupplier(Supplier)}.
163       *
164       * @param value The client secret.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
165       * @return This object.
166       */
167      public Builder clientSecret(String value) {
168         reqnb("value", value);
169         clientSecretSupplier = () -> value;
170         return this;
171      }
172
173      /**
174       * Sets the OAuth client secret via a supplier (useful for rotating secrets).
175       *
176       * @param value The supplier.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
177       * @return This object.
178       */
179      public Builder clientSecretSupplier(Supplier<String> value) {
180         clientSecretSupplier = reqnn("value", value);
181         return this;
182      }
183
184      /**
185       * Sets a custom token cache.  Defaults to a {@link BoundedLruTokenCache} with 1000 entries.
186       *
187       * @param value The cache.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
188       * @return This object.
189       */
190      public Builder tokenCache(TokenCache value) {
191         tokenCache = reqnn("value", value);
192         return this;
193      }
194
195      /**
196       * Sets the cache TTL.  Defaults to {@link #DEFAULT_CACHE_TTL 5 minutes}; capped at
197       * {@link #MAX_CACHE_TTL 1 hour}.  Capped by the token's own {@code exp} when shorter.
198       *
199       * @param value The TTL.  Must be positive and not exceed 1 hour.
200       * @return This object.
201       */
202      public Builder cacheTtl(Duration value) {
203         reqnn("value", value);
204         if (value.isZero() || value.isNegative())
205            throw iaex("cacheTtl must be positive");
206         if (value.compareTo(MAX_CACHE_TTL) > 0)
207            throw iaex("cacheTtl must not exceed 1 hour (was %s)", value);
208         cacheTtl = value;
209         return this;
210      }
211
212      /**
213       * Adds required scopes (scope enforcement lives on the validator, not the filter).
214       *
215       * <p>
216       * If any required scope is missing from the introspection response's {@code scope} claim, the
217       * validator throws {@link AuthenticationException} with
218       * {@code WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="insufficient_scope"}.
219       *
220       * @param scopes The required scopes.  Must contain at least one non-blank entry.
221       * @return This object.
222       */
223      public Builder requiredScopes(String... scopes) {
224         reqnn("scopes", scopes);
225         for (var s : scopes) {
226            reqnb("scope", s);
227            requiredScopes.add(s);
228         }
229         return this;
230      }
231
232      /**
233       * Adds expected audience values (RFC 7662 {@code aud}) that a token must carry to be accepted.
234       *
235       * <p>
236       * When at least one value is configured here (via this method or {@link #resource(String...)}), the
237       * introspection response's {@code aud} claim must contain <b>at least one</b> matching value, or the
238       * token is rejected as {@code invalid_token} &mdash; even when {@code active=true} and required scopes
239       * match.  This binds the token to the resource server it was minted for, so a token issued for a
240       * different API cannot be replayed against this one.
241       *
242       * <p>
243       * An audience is required: {@link #build()} fails unless at least one value is configured here or
244       * {@link #anyAudience()} is called.
245       *
246       * @param values The expected audience values.  Must contain at least one non-blank entry.
247       * @return This object.
248       */
249      public Builder audience(String... values) {
250         reqnn("values", values);
251         for (var v : values) {
252            reqnb("audience", v);
253            expectedAudiences.add(v);
254         }
255         return this;
256      }
257
258      /**
259       * Explicitly disables the audience check.
260       *
261       * <p>
262       * Use only for authorization servers that cannot emit an {@code aud} claim.  Without this call (or an
263       * {@link #audience(String...)} value), {@link #build()} fails.
264       *
265       * @return This object.
266       */
267      public Builder anyAudience() {
268         anyAudience = true;
269         return this;
270      }
271
272      /**
273       * Sets the expected token issuer.
274       *
275       * <p>
276       * When set, the introspection response's {@code iss} claim must equal this value or the token is rejected.
277       *
278       * @param value The expected issuer.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
279       * @return This object.
280       */
281      public Builder issuer(String value) {
282         issuer = reqnb("value", value);
283         return this;
284      }
285
286      /**
287       * Sets the connect/read timeout of the introspection call.  Defaults to {@link #DEFAULT_HTTP_TIMEOUT 5 seconds}.
288       *
289       * <p>
290       * Applied before {@link #httpRequestConfigurator(Consumer)} runs, so the configurator can override it.
291       *
292       * @param value The timeout.  Must be positive.
293       * @return This object.
294       */
295      public Builder httpTimeout(Duration value) {
296         reqnn("value", value);
297         if (value.isZero() || value.isNegative())
298            throw iaex("httpTimeout must be positive");
299         httpTimeout = value;
300         return this;
301      }
302
303      /**
304       * Sets how long an inactive or rejected token is remembered so repeated presentations do not each trigger
305       * an introspection call.  Defaults to {@link #DEFAULT_NEGATIVE_CACHE_TTL 30 seconds}; {@link Duration#ZERO} disables it.
306       *
307       * @param value The TTL.  Must not be negative.
308       * @return This object.
309       */
310      public Builder negativeCacheTtl(Duration value) {
311         reqnn("value", value);
312         if (value.isNegative())
313            throw iaex("negativeCacheTtl must not be negative");
314         negativeCacheTtl = value;
315         return this;
316      }
317
318      /**
319       * Adds expected resource-indicator values (RFC 8707).
320       *
321       * <p>
322       * Alias for {@link #audience(String...)}: RFC 8707 resource indicators are echoed back by
323       * conformant authorization servers in the same introspection {@code aud} claim as RFC 7662
324       * audiences, so both methods add to the same expected-value set.
325       *
326       * @param values The expected resource values.  Must contain at least one non-blank entry.
327       * @return This object.
328       */
329      public Builder resource(String... values) {
330         return audience(values);
331      }
332
333      /**
334       * Overrides the {@link Clock} used for cache expiry.  Useful in tests.
335       *
336       * @param value The clock.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
337       * @return This object.
338       */
339      public Builder clock(Clock value) {
340         clock = reqnn("value", value);
341         return this;
342      }
343
344      /**
345       * Sets a callback that customizes the Nimbus {@link HTTPRequest} before it is sent.
346       *
347       * <p>
348       * This is the escape hatch for custom HTTP behavior (proxies, TLS overrides,
349       * timeout overrides).  The callback is invoked on every introspection call.
350       *
351       * @param value The configurator callback.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
352       * @return This object.
353       */
354      public Builder httpRequestConfigurator(Consumer<HTTPRequest> value) {
355         httpRequestConfigurator = reqnn("value", value);
356         return this;
357      }
358
359      /**
360       * Requires the introspection response to carry a {@code token_type} of {@code Bearer} or
361       * {@code access_token}.
362       *
363       * <p>
364       * When {@code false} (the default), a response without {@code token_type} is accepted, but a response
365       * whose {@code token_type} is present and is not {@code Bearer} / {@code access_token} (for example
366       * {@code refresh_token} or {@code id_token}) is always rejected.
367       *
368       * @param value {@code true} to require {@code token_type} to be present.
369       * @return This object.
370       */
371      public Builder requireTokenType(boolean value) {
372         requireTokenType = value;
373         return this;
374      }
375
376      /**
377       * Builds the validator.
378       *
379       * @return A new {@link OAuthIntrospectionValidator}.
380       */
381      public OAuthIntrospectionValidator build() {
382         if (introspectionEndpoint == null)
383            throw new IllegalStateException("OAuthIntrospectionValidator requires introspectionEndpoint(...)");
384         if (clientId == null)
385            throw new IllegalStateException("OAuthIntrospectionValidator requires clientId(...)");
386         if (clientSecretSupplier == null)
387            throw new IllegalStateException("OAuthIntrospectionValidator requires clientSecret(...) or clientSecretSupplier(...)");
388         if (expectedAudiences.isEmpty() && ! anyAudience)
389            throw new IllegalStateException("OAuthIntrospectionValidator requires audience(...) or an explicit anyAudience()");
390         if (tokenCache == null)
391            tokenCache = BoundedLruTokenCache.create();
392         return new OAuthIntrospectionValidator(this);
393      }
394   }

396   private final URI introspectionEndpoint;
397   private final String clientId;
398   private final Supplier<String> clientSecretSupplier;
399   private final TokenCache tokenCache;
400   private final Duration cacheTtl;
401   private final Set<String> requiredScopes;
402   private final Set<String> expectedAudiences;
403   private final Clock clock;
404   private final Consumer<HTTPRequest> httpRequestConfigurator;
405   private final String issuer;
406   private final Duration httpTimeout;
407   private final Duration negativeCacheTtl;
408   private final boolean requireTokenType;
409   private final Map<String,NegativeEntry> negativeCache = new LinkedHashMap<>(16, 0.75f, true) {
410      private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
411      @Override
412      protected boolean removeEldestEntry(Map.Entry<String,NegativeEntry> eldest) {
413         return size() > MAX_NEGATIVE_ENTRIES;
414      }
415   };
416
417   /** Raw introspection result as stored in the token cache; carries no per-validator decisions. */
418   private record RawIntrospection(TokenIntrospectionSuccessResponse response) implements Principal {
419      @Override /* Overridden from Principal */
420      public String getName() {
421         return response.getSubject() == null ? "" : response.getSubject().getValue();
422      }
423   }
424
425   private record NegativeEntry(String message, String wwwAuthenticate, Instant expires) {}
426
427   private static final class Rejection extends Exception {
428      private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
429      private final String challenge;
430      Rejection(String message, String challenge) {
431         super(message);
432         this.challenge = challenge;
433      }
434      AuthenticationException toException() {
435         return new AuthenticationException(getMessage()).wwwAuthenticate(challenge);
436      }
437   }

446      this.clientId = b.clientId;
447      this.clientSecretSupplier = b.clientSecretSupplier;
448      this.tokenCache = b.tokenCache;
449      this.cacheTtl = b.cacheTtl;
450      this.requiredScopes = u(cp(b.requiredScopes));
451      this.expectedAudiences = u(cp(b.expectedAudiences));
452      this.clock = b.clock;
453      this.httpRequestConfigurator = b.httpRequestConfigurator;
454      this.issuer = b.issuer;
455      this.httpTimeout = b.httpTimeout;
456      this.negativeCacheTtl = b.negativeCacheTtl;
457      this.requireTokenType = b.requireTokenType;
458   }

505   /**
506    * Returns the underlying token cache.

508    * @return The token cache.

513
514   @Override /* Overridden from TokenValidator */
515   public Principal validate(String token) throws AuthenticationException {
516      reqnb("token", token);
517      var cached = tokenCache.getPrincipal(token);
518      if (cached.isPresent() && cached.get() instanceof RawIntrospection raw) {
519         // The cache holds only the raw introspection result, so a cache shared with a differently
520         // configured validator can never skip this validator's own checks.
521         try {
522            enforceNotExpired(raw.response());
523            return toPrincipal(raw.response());
524         } catch (Rejection e) {
525            throw e.toException();
526         }
527      }
528      checkNegativeCache(token);
529      return introspect(token);
530   }
531
532   private static String negativeKey(String token) {
533      try {
534         return HexFormat.of().formatHex(MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(token.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));
535      } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException e) {
536         throw new IllegalStateException(e);
537      }
538   }
539
540   private void checkNegativeCache(String token) throws AuthenticationException {
541      if (negativeCacheTtl.isZero())
542         return;
543      NegativeEntry e;
544      synchronized (negativeCache) {
545         var key = negativeKey(token);
546         e = negativeCache.get(key);
547         if (e != null && ! e.expires().isAfter(clock.instant())) {
548            negativeCache.remove(key);
549            e = null;
550         }
551      }
552      if (e != null)
553         throw new AuthenticationException(e.message()).wwwAuthenticate(e.wwwAuthenticate());
554   }
555
556   private AuthenticationException remember(String token, Rejection r) {
557      if (! negativeCacheTtl.isZero()) {
558         synchronized (negativeCache) {
559            negativeCache.put(negativeKey(token), new NegativeEntry(r.getMessage(), r.challenge, clock.instant().plus(negativeCacheTtl)));
560         }
561      }
562      return r.toException();
563   }
564
565   private Principal introspect(String token) throws AuthenticationException {
566      var clientAuth = new ClientSecretBasic(new ClientID(clientId),
567         new com.nimbusds.oauth2.sdk.auth.Secret(clientSecretSupplier.get()));
568      AccessToken accessToken = new BearerAccessToken(token);
569      var req = new TokenIntrospectionRequest(introspectionEndpoint, clientAuth, accessToken);
570      var http = req.toHTTPRequest();
571      var timeoutMs = (int)Math.min(httpTimeout.toMillis(), Integer.MAX_VALUE);
572      http.setConnectTimeout(timeoutMs);
573      http.setReadTimeout(timeoutMs);
574      http.setFollowRedirects(false);
575      if (httpRequestConfigurator != null)
576         httpRequestConfigurator.accept(http);
577
578      com.nimbusds.oauth2.sdk.http.HTTPResponse httpResp;
579      try {
580         httpResp = http.send();
581      } catch (IOException e) {
582         throw new AuthenticationException(e, "OAuth introspection HTTP call failed")
583            .wwwAuthenticate(bearerError("invalid_token", "introspection unreachable"));
584      }
585      TokenIntrospectionResponse resp;
586      try {
587         resp = TokenIntrospectionResponse.parse(httpResp);
588      } catch (ParseException e) {
589         throw new AuthenticationException(e, "OAuth introspection response could not be parsed")
590            .wwwAuthenticate(bearerError("invalid_token", "introspection parse failed"));
591      }
592      if (!resp.indicatesSuccess())
593         throw remember(token, new Rejection("OAuth introspection error: " + safeErrorCode(resp.toErrorResponse().getErrorObject().getCode()),
594            bearerError("invalid_token", safeErrorCode(resp.toErrorResponse().getErrorObject().getCode()))));
595      var success = resp.toSuccessResponse();
596      if (!success.isActive())
597         throw remember(token, new Rejection("OAuth token inactive", bearerError("invalid_token", "token inactive")));
598      Principal principal;
599      try {
600         principal = toPrincipal(success);
601      } catch (Rejection e) {
602         throw remember(token, e);
603      }
604      tokenCache.putPrincipal(token, new RawIntrospection(success), resolveTtl(success));
605      return principal;
606   }
607
608   private Principal toPrincipal(TokenIntrospectionSuccessResponse success) throws Rejection {
609      enforceTokenType(success);
610      enforceIssuer(success);
611      enforceAudience(success);
612      var scopes = extractScopes(success);
613      enforceRequiredScopes(scopes);
614      var claims = buildClaims(success, scopes);
615      if (success.getSubject() == null || success.getSubject().getValue().isBlank())
616         throw new Rejection("OAuth token has no subject", bearerError("invalid_token", "subject missing"));
617      var subject = success.getSubject().getValue();
618      return new ClaimsPrincipal(subject, claims);
619   }
620
621   private void enforceNotExpired(TokenIntrospectionSuccessResponse success) throws Rejection {
622      var exp = success.getExpirationTime();
623      if (exp != null && ! exp.toInstant().isAfter(clock.instant()))
624         throw new Rejection("OAuth token expired", bearerError("invalid_token", "token expired"));
625   }
626
627   private void enforceTokenType(TokenIntrospectionSuccessResponse success) throws Rejection {
628      var type = success.getStringParameter("token_type");
629      if (type == null) {
630         if (requireTokenType)
631            throw new Rejection("OAuth token type missing", bearerError("invalid_token", "token type missing"));
632         return;
633      }
634      if (! (eqic(type, "Bearer") || eqic(type, "access_token")))
635         throw new Rejection("OAuth token is not an access token", bearerError("invalid_token", "token type not accepted"));
636   }
637
638   private void enforceIssuer(TokenIntrospectionSuccessResponse success) throws Rejection {
639      if (issuer == null)
640         return;
641      var iss = success.getIssuer();
642      if (iss == null || neq(issuer, iss.getValue()))
643         throw new Rejection("OAuth token issuer mismatch", bearerError("invalid_token", "issuer mismatch"));
644   }
645
646   private Set<String> extractScopes(TokenIntrospectionSuccessResponse success) {
647      var s = success.getScope();
648      if (s == null)
649         return Collections.emptySet();
650      return s.toStringList().stream()
651         .filter(v -> v != null && !v.isBlank()) // HTT: v==null branch unreachable; Nimbus Scope.toStringList() never returns null entries
652         .collect(Collectors.toCollection(LinkedHashSet::new));
653   }
654
655   /**
656    * Rejects the token when an expected audience/resource set is configured and the introspection
657    * response's {@code aud} claim contains none of the expected values.  No-op when
658    * {@link #expectedAudiences} is empty (explicit {@code anyAudience()}).
659    */
660   private void enforceAudience(TokenIntrospectionSuccessResponse success) throws Rejection {
661      if (expectedAudiences.isEmpty())
662         return;
663      var tokenAudiences = success.getAudience();
664      var matched = tokenAudiences != null && tokenAudiences.stream()
665         .map(Audience::getValue)
666         .anyMatch(expectedAudiences::contains);
667      if (!matched)
668         throw new Rejection("OAuth token audience/resource mismatch", bearerError("invalid_token", "audience mismatch"));
669   }
670
671   private void enforceRequiredScopes(Set<String> tokenScopes) throws Rejection {
672      for (var req : requiredScopes) {
673         if (!tokenScopes.contains(req))
674            throw new Rejection("Required scope missing: " + req, bearerError("insufficient_scope", "scope " + req + " missing"));
675      }
676   }
677
678   private Map<String,Object> buildClaims(TokenIntrospectionSuccessResponse success, Set<String> scopes) {
679      var claims = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>(success.toJSONObject());
680      if (!scopes.isEmpty())
681         claims.put("scope", new ArrayList<>(scopes));
682      return claims;
683   }
684
685   private Duration resolveTtl(TokenIntrospectionSuccessResponse success) {
686      var ttl = cacheTtl;
687      var exp = success.getExpirationTime();
688      if (exp != null) {
689         var until = Duration.between(clock.instant(), exp.toInstant());
690         if (until.isNegative() || until.isZero())
691            until = Duration.ofSeconds(1);
692         if (until.compareTo(ttl) < 0)
693            ttl = until;
694      }
695      return ttl;
696   }
697
698   private static String bearerError(String code, String description) {
699      return "Bearer error=\"" + code + "\", error_description=\"" + description.replace('"', ' ') + "\"";
700   }
701
702   private static String safeErrorCode(String code) {
703      if (code == null || code.isEmpty() || ! code.matches("[\\x20\\x21\\x23-\\x5B\\x5D-\\x7E]+"))
704         return "invalid_token";
705      return code;
706   }
707}
